question: Should OpenClaw deprecate these 37 released bundled skills now and designate Sherpa ONNX TTS as an official ClawHub-only trusted package under the proposed install behavior?
rationale: The code can implement either direction, but deciding which released skills remain first-party defaults and which ClawHub packages receive official trust changes product scope, upgrade expectations, and the security boundary.

options.title: Land with migration and trust proof
options.body: Proceed with the trim after adding doctor migration, confirming every intended external replacement, approving the exact dependency head, and proving fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Split Sherpa from skill trimming
options.body: Review the Sherpa ClawHub-only package and install-resolution contract independently while leaving bundled-skill availability unchanged.

options.title: Keep the released starter set
options.body: Close or park the broad trim and continue moving only clearly owner-bound or individually approved skills through narrow PRs.

recommendation.title: Land with migration and trust proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with the trim after adding doctor migration, confirming every intended external replacement, approving the exact dependency head, and proving fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They performed the recent splits, validated both adjacent merged changes, and explicitly identified this PR as the remaining bundled-skill and Sherpa packaging decision surface.
